methodologyNote: This registry operates at CAPABILITY granularity (one row per Gate-20-style lettered domain), not at the individual-MD-bullet granularity the separate 612-row Client Discovery registry (BUSINESS_CONCIERGE_MASTER_MD_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json) uses. Re-atomizing all 7 canonical sources to that same bullet-level rigor was judged infeasible within this session's resource budget and is disclosed here honestly rather than fabricated. Client Discovery's own 612 atomic rows are NOT duplicated in this file -- see AU_CLIENT_DISCOVERY below, which references that existing durable artifact by pointer rather than re-deriving it. Every other domain's STATUS below is backed by direct evidence gathered this session: live Staging DB table introspection (project cgeehvnfyrdoperdotdh), 3 independent Explore-agent source-code audits (Staff Command Center UI, Growth Engine UI, Authorization + Owner Dashboard boundary), and direct file reads/greps performed by the auditing session itself -- never from documentation claims or prior gate summaries alone.
